stated_size_criteria.sentence: Independent sponsor acquiring consumer brands with $1M–$5M EBITDA

Preserve Equity Partners is an independent sponsor that acquires founder- and family-owned consumer businesses in the lower middle market, typically with $1M–$5M of EBITDA. Our partners are operators who have built, scaled and sold consumer brands. When we acquire a company, we don’t arrive with a cost-cutting playbook. We learn what’s already driving the business, protect it, and put our time, capital and experience behind growing it.

At Preserve Equity Partners (PEP), we acquire entrepreneur- and family-owned consumer businesses in the lower middle market with $1M–$5M of EBITDA. We focus on consumer brands, consumer products and eCommerce/DTC companies, where our operating background can drive outsized growth through brand building, operational improvement, digital transformation and expanded distribution.
